name: BP-BASSENSORSMKII Sensors BoosterPack plug-in module
sources: User guide SLAU829 (May 2020: Figure 2 drawing, section 2.1.2 addresses, Tables 1 to 6, Figure 9 schematic); F3 SDK 9.21 board file source/ti/boards/.meta/boosterpacks/BP-BASSENSORSMKII.syscfg.json; read 2026-10-07

columns.head: The sensors
items: Within 0.1 C, I2C 0x48. Sits on the break-away board, joined by the ribbon cable
Light as the eye sees it, I2C 0x44
Accelerometer and gyro (0x69) with a compass chip behind it (0x13)
Analog voltage on pin 2 that rises with field strength

columns.head: Header pins it uses
items: All five digital sensors share it; 10 kOhm pull-ups are on the board
Pin 27 powers the OPT3001 and 28 the TMP117 (high = on); 6 and 24 enable the HDC2080 and DRV5055 (low = on)
5 and 13 motion, 8 compass, 23 humidity, 25 light, 26 temperature

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: The board and a 3-inch ribbon cable; the TMP117 reads nothing until the cable is in
No processor, no radio: it is sensors only
Heat and shade from a board stacked on top skew the readings (SLAU829 2.1.1)
